item.title: The Humboldt River Field Office has Concluded the Jakes Fire Emergency Wild Horse Gather
item.description: On January 26, 2026, the Humboldt River Field Office (HRFO) began the 2026 Jakes Fire emergency wild horse gather and concluded the operation on January 30, 2026. The gather was located on the Snowstorm and Little Humboldt Herd Management Areas located approximately 45 miles northeast of Winnemucca in Humboldt County, Nevada.
